name: Esusu
positioning: A rent-reporting and financial wellness platform that turns on-time rent into credit history for residents.
description: Esusu is a fintech platform for real estate operators built around rent reporting: it reports payments to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion so residents build credit, and layers on flexible payment options, income and identity fraud verification, financial coaching and portfolio analytics for property owners.
real_estate_use: A multifamily operator rolls out Esusu across a portfolio so residents' on-time rent is reported to the three bureaus without extra paperwork, while the operator's screening team uses the same platform's identity and income verification to catch fraudulent applications before move-in. During renewal season, the operator's analytics dashboard shows which properties are seeing the credit-building benefit move renewal rates.
features: Rent reporting to three major credit bureaus
Identity, income and SSN fraud verification
Flexible rent payment options (Affirm, split pay)

use_cases.job: Report resident rent payments to credit bureaus across a portfolio
Build credit history and access flexible rent payment options
